about: Every number and claim this lesson shows or says, with its source, all re-opened Nov 5, 2026 (video/studio/videos/2026-11-17-after-hours-robot/00_story/story.md, Receipts). jobber.atLimit: Continue and pay overages, or Pause Receptionist (paused: takes messages, cannot book)
jobber.disclosure: 'We encourage you to let callers know that your phone is answered by AI.' Not required.
jobber.afterHoursOnly: set with your phone carrier's call forwarding (outside business hours or after a number of rings), not in Jobber
jobber.plan: an add-on on select plans; included with unlimited use on the Plus plan

rural.what: a small rural business misses many calls and asks whether customers will distrust an AI receptionist; a long-time user replies it is hit and miss, few callers stay on the line once they hear it is AI, and uses it after hours as a better voicemail
rural.age: about Nov 4, 2026 (page shows 1 day ago on Nov 5)
rural.who: a Jobber Ambassador (a long-time user), replying in thread 9584; the same person says few callers stay and calls it a better voicemail
rural.quote: hardly anyone stays in the call longer than hearing it's AI
rural.alsoSays: has it tell callers it's AI and may turn that off

treeService.what: a tree service turned the AI receptionist off after it mismatched existing clients, created odd tasks and confused older clients, and went back to voicemail with transcripts (CallRail); the reply has no date, the thread's first post shows 5 months ago

backflow.what: a backflow company buried in AI receptionist pitches; advice: after hours only, a person is better for now

consensus.what: across threads 7842 and 15510 and the reply in 9584, owners land on AI at night (after hours, days off) and a person by day

example.greeting: You've reached us after hours. I'm our AI assistant. I can book you for tomorrow or take the details now.
